title: Explain the D1 data model
goal: Add a small diagram and plain-language description of sources, jobs, existing Notion pages, and application attempts to docs/architecture.md.
done: A reader can trace one posting from a company feed to its Notion page and see where duplicate prevention happens.

title: Add role-lane classification tests
goal: Add focused tests for ML Engineering, Data Science, Applied Science, Research, ambiguous job titles, and the forward-deployed scientist exception.
done: npm run check passes and the tests reject generic SWE/FDE openings while keeping clearly early-career scientist roles.

title: Make the start date configurable
goal: Replace the hard-coded June 2027 availability in matching and profile validation with one typed setting, while keeping the current live default.
done: The configured date is used consistently in matching, application checks, and tests.

title: Improve source coverage reporting
goal: Show which company boards succeeded, failed, or need manual checks in a small, readable report generated from service status.
done: A failed feed is visibly different from a feed with zero matching jobs.

title: Build a synthetic demo dataset
goal: Create a small fake set of jobs and tracker rows that demonstrates the product without exposing personal Notion data.
done: The example dataset can power a screenshot or local demo and contains no real applicant information.

title: Prototype a read-only web dashboard
goal: Create a small frontend using the synthetic dataset to show role filters, fit reasons, source status, and application stages.
done: A recruiter can open a local demo without a Notion account or private token.

title: Polish the recruiter demo
goal: Add a screenshot or short walkthrough, accessibility checks, and a clear explanation of the project's tradeoffs.
done: The README links to a demo artifact and explains what is real versus simulated.
